text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear intro with position and reasons","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a recognizable argumentative structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and a conclusion that are easy to follow."},{"evidence":"multiple developed paragraphs with transitions like “First,” “Next,” and “Then,”","quality":"coherence","description":"It connects ideas in a logical sequence so the argument unfolds more smoothly from point to point."},{"evidence":"quoted article details followed by explanation","quality":"elaboration","description":"It does more than cite the source by explaining how each detail supports the claim that driverless cars are unsafe."},{"evidence":"direct claim that cars are “dangerous” and “unsafe to drive”","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It maintains a consistent position against driverless cars and keeps returning to that central claim."},{"evidence":"conclusion restates the position and sums up the reasons","quality":"closure","description":"It ends by bringing the essay back to the main argument instead of stopping abruptly."}]}
